newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health sets line of credit.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health sets line of credit.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc said it has established a new unsecured revolving line of credit of $1.5 billion.
The lending syndicate is led by BankAmerica Corp and Citicorp and includes several other banks.

FHS was created by the April 1, 1997 merger involving Foundation Health Corporation (FHC) and Health Systems International Inc (HSI). The new facility replaces HSI's prior $700 million facility and FHC's prior $300 million and $200 million facilities. Previous borrowings under these prior facilities have been rolled into the new line of credit.
